item.title: First Lady Melania Trump Unveils New Fostering the Future Together Technology Alliances, International Events, and Membership Expansion

The White HouseSeptember 22, 2026
First Lady Melania Trump today reconvened members of Fostering the Future Together during the 81st United Nations General Assembly.
The First Lady welcomed leaders from around the world, including representatives from the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, Republic of Korea, the Philippines, Poland, Ukraine, Türkiye, the United Arab Emirates, Panama, Canada, and other nations.
First Lady Melania Trump remarked, “Together, we are a beautiful range of cultures, languages, histories, and traditions. And yet, we stand unified around one everlasting truth: the future of our world will be determined by what we do for our children today.”
First Lady Melania Trump unveiled several upcoming Fostering the Future Together events for 2026:
“When nations speak with one voice, the world listens. Our collective influence is profound. Together, we can open doors, move markets, shape policy. And most importantly, we can change lives for the better,” First Lady Melania Trump said.
First Lady Melania Trump also announced new private-sector technology partnerships with Adobe, Amazon, Intel, Starlink, Google, and Zoom. Tim Cook, Executive Chairman of Apple and Enrique Lores, CEO of PayPal, also attended.
The First Lady welcomed new member nations, expanding Fostering the Future Together to fifty-seven participating countries.
Calling on the assembled First Spouses to act, First Lady Melania Trump said, “Our Fostering the Future Together coalition must strive to empower the youth of our nations to: bend the boundaries of imagination, explore new frontiers of intellect, have the courage to take calculated risks, and build toward advancement of society.”
About Fostering the Future Together:Fostering the Future Together is a global coalition of nations unified to empower children through technology and education.
First Lady Melania Trump announced Fostering the Future Together during the 80th United Nations General Assembly. In spring 2026, she convened the initiative’s two-day Global Coalition Summit in Washington DC, bringing together First Spouses and technology-sector leaders at the United States Department of State. The gathering culminated at the White House, where the First Lady welcomed the largest assembly of First Spouses ever convened there for diplomatic purposes in U.S. history.
The First Lady’s remarks, as prepared for delivery, are below.
Fostering the Future Together Expands Nation Memberships, Private-Sector Commitments, & Unveils New Events
Thank you, Special Envoy Wallace and Ambassador Waltz. Your ongoing commitment to support Fostering the Future Together is both important and meaningful.
Friends, Excellencies, and Distinguished Leaders. Welcome to New York City.
Fostering the Future Together now unites nearly 60 nations, many represented here today. You have traveled great distances in support of our children, bringing together distinguished leaders from Panama, the Republic of Korea, Kenya, Albania, Estonia, Dominican Republic, Guatemala and beyond.
Together, we are a beautiful range of cultures, languages, histories, and traditions.
And yet, we stand unified around one everlasting truth: the future of our world will be determined by what we do for our children today.
Fostering the Future Together is more than a coalition. It is a commitment to empower children through technology and education, to ensure that every child, regardless of where they are born, has the opportunity to imagine, learn, create, and thrive.
When nations speak with one voice, the world listens. Our collective influence is profound. Together, we can open doors, move markets, shape policy. And most importantly, we can change lives for the better.
Each of us has been entrusted with the responsibility of leadership.
But mark my words, our success will not be measured solely by what we accomplish during our time in this role. Our success as leaders will be measured by what remains after we are gone.
Did we strengthen our schools? Did we make new discoveries possible? Did we inspire greater innovation?
And most importantly, will the next generation be able to build upon our vision and use our accomplishments to advance their careers, families, communities, and nations?
So, I ask you: Will you join me and lead? Will you put the future of our children above the difference...

item.title: First Lady Melania Trump Releases Details on the State Dinner with His Excellency Xi Jinping, President of The People’s Republic of China, and Madame Peng Liyuan

Office of the First Lady
The White HouseSeptember 24, 2026
President Donald J. Trump and First Lady Melania Trump will welcome His Excellency Xi Jinping, President of The People’s Republic of China, and Madame Peng Liyuan for a State Dinner in the East Room of the White House this evening. The First Lady led the preparations for the dinner, which will be attended by the official delegations as well as business leaders and government officials.
The menu showcases American ingredients with subtle Chinese influence, bringing the culinary traditions of both nations together. The meal begins with a toast of Schramsberg “Blanc De Noir,” honoring the historic “Toast to Peace” shared by President Nixon and Premier Zhou Enlai in Beijing in 1972. The same American sparkling wine served at that historic gathering continues to be enjoyed at White House functions today.
First CourseYellow Squash VeloutéWild Mushroom FricasséeCrispy PancettaScallion Oil
The first course offers a refined and silky-smooth velouté made of sweet yellow squash. This course is gently blended to highlight its delicate seasonal flavors of earthy wild mushrooms, sautéed with fresh herbs. Together, these ingredients create a rich fricassee, complemented by crispy pancetta for a savory and smoky contrast. A finishing drizzle of scallion oil adds vibrance and a subtle allium brightness to the dish.
Second CourseSesame Crusted Sea BassBraised Baby Bok ChoyRoasted Garden EggplantSauce Verte
The second course is prepared delicately with fresh seabass and coated in toasted sesame seeds. This combination creates a fragrant nutty crust while keeping the fish tender. The fish is served with crisp baby bok choy and roasted garden eggplant, creating lightly caramelized flavors. The dish is finished with a vibrant sauce verte of fresh herbs, which add brightness, acidity, and a garden character.
DessertVanilla Crémeux & White House Honey Ice CreamWalnut FrangipaneSour Cherry Confit The dessert course is a smooth vanilla crémeux with a vibrant sour cherry confit center, set a top a rich walnut frangipane. The dessert’s fruit shaped form is complimented by a delicate ice cream made with harvested White House honey.
There will be several performances during the formal dinner, which will be headlined by Mr. Christopher Macchio, a classically trained tenor who performed at the 2025 Presidential Inauguration. The evening’s entertainment will feature performances by military musicians from the United States Marines Corps and the United States Army, including “The President’s Own” United States Marine Band, “The Commandant’s Own” United States Marine Drum and Bugle Corps, the United States Army Chorus, and the United States Army Strings.
The décor for the evening is an expression of warmth and celebration and draws on the color red’s longstanding cultural significance throughout Chinese history. Urns showcase overflowing red blossoms. Tables are dressed in rich red linens and adorned with dahlias and ranunculus. Among the seasonal blooms, the tables feature vermeil from the White House collection. The Reagan State Service is featured on the tables. These details blend Chinese artistry and American tradition together, showcased within the timeless elegance of the White House.

item.title: Presidential Message on the Beatification of Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen
item.description:
Briefings & StatementsPresidential Message on the Beatification of Archbishop Fulton J. SheenThe White HouseSeptember 24, 2026

Briefings & StatementsPresidential Message on the Beatification of Archbishop Fulton J. SheenThe White HouseSeptember 24, 2026
Briefings & Statements
The White HouseSeptember 24, 2026
Melania and I join all those celebrating the life and legacy of Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen—the Catholic priest who pioneered the use of media to speak the truth, preach the Gospel, and bring many souls closer to Christ. Today, Archbishop Sheen will become the first-ever American-born bishop to be beatified by the Catholic Church.
Born on the plains of central Illinois at the twilight of the nineteenth century, Fulton Sheen was blessed with extraordinary intelligence, good humor, and eloquence. After his ordination to the priesthood, he spent more than two decades teaching, lecturing, and broadcasting on the radio before he was consecrated Auxiliary Bishop of New York in 1951. With a growing reputation as a world-class preacher and evangelist, he then launched his renowned national television series,Life Is Worth Living, which soon captivated the entire country.
On his show, Archbishop Sheen lectured before a live audience on an array of theological, philosophical, and political topics. Dressed in striking priestly robes and armed with only a chalk stick and blackboard, he quickly emerged as a primetime sensation—boldly bringing the teachings of Christianity to a world threatened by the titanic forces of communism.
Archbishop Sheen shocked the entertainment industry by besting American legends like Milton Berle and Frank Sinatra in weekly ratings, winning an Emmy award for Most Outstanding Television Personality, and appearing on the cover ofTimemagazine. For years, his sharp wit and piercing intellect filled millions of American living rooms and converted thousands—including national politicians, Hollywood celebrities, and communist leaders—to the Catholic faith. His program attracted an estimated 30 million weekly viewers, ultimately becoming one of the most watched religious programs in the history of television. Through it all, Archbishop Sheen used his platform not for his own sake but to strengthen our Nation with the good news of the Gospel.
In the 1960s, against the rising tide of anti-God extremism in American culture, Archbishop Sheen turned to the camera to identify a “new type of violence that’s sweeping our country, our schools, and our streets.” This violence, he warned in his later careerThe Fulton Sheen Program, “involves destruction of everything that is in the past.” He continued, “Our Nation is too full of those that are crying, “Down… Down with schools. Down with the churches. Down with teachers. Down with government. Down with the police. Can you build anything down?” he implored the Nation. “You cannot… Let’s begin now to use the word ‘Up.’ Up from all of this filth. Up from this violence… Up—up to God.”
Sheen was later appointed as the Bishop of Rochester, New York, and the titular Archbishop of Newport, Wales. In October 1979, Pope John Paul II, the leader of the Roman Catholic Church, embraced Archbishop Sheen in Saint Patrick’s Cathedral in New York City, telling him, “You have written and spoken well of the Lord Jesus. You are a loyal son of the Church.” Archbishop Sheen died just two months later while praying in his private chapel.
Archbishop Fulton Sheen’s legacy endures in homes, churches, and communities all across our country. Countless Americans still watch recordings of his broadcasts and read his books. The Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen Museum in his native Illinois attracts thousands of visitors every year. And today, as thousands of Americans gather in St. Louis, Missouri, for his Beatification Mass, we pray that Archbishop Sheen’s heroic commitment to nourishing the soul of our country will inspire others to follow his example and lift our Nation upward and ever higher to God.

Presidential Message on National Hunting and Fishing Day

Briefings & Statements
The White HouseSeptember 26, 2026
For over 250 years, America’s hunters and anglers have been faithful stewards of our great outdoors—respecting the land, pursuing their sport with honor, and preserving our lands and waters. On National Hunting and Fishing Day, we pay tribute to the American sportsmen, hunters, and fishermen who protect our abundant resources, cherish our Nation’s natural beauty, and sustain one of the oldest and proudest customs in American life.
Hunting and fishing have fed our families, tamed our frontier, and shaped the character of our people since the very beginning of our national story. Today, American outdoorsmen are the backbone of conservation, passing their skills and respect for the land from one generation to the next. They also support a thriving outdoor economy that sustains jobs, strengthens rural communities, and contributes billions of dollars into the wild places they love through every license, tag, and piece of gear they buy.
My Administration has proudly carried forward this great tradition by giving Americans more access to their public lands than ever before. During my first term, I signed the Great American Outdoors Act—the single largest investment in America’s national parks and public lands in history and the most significant conservation achievement since Teddy Roosevelt’s Presidency. I also enacted landmark legislation protecting 1.3 million new acres of wilderness and unlocked more than 2.3 million acres for American sportsmen, and we recovered more endangered and threatened species than any prior administration in a single term.
Just this month, I was proud to sign an Executive Order to reinvigorate America’s hunting heritage, opening new hunting opportunities on federal lands—including places long cut off from sportsmen due to Federal overreach—and expanding Sunday hunting across our Nation. This order also directs my Cabinet to work alongside the States to promote thriving populations of America’s iconic game species, and it prioritizes incentives that cultivate the hunting tradition in young Americans and veterans like never before. In addition, I signed an Executive Order to restore American saltwater angling and recreation, slashing burdensome regulations on boaters, anglers, and outdoor businesses; modernizing catch reporting; rebuilding prized stocks like the Atlantic Striped Bass; and turning retired offshore platforms into flourishing artificial reefs.
My Administration was also proud to reestablish the Hunting and Shooting Conservation and Access Council earlier this year, calling on distinguished sportsmen and conservation leaders from across the country to council the Federal Government on conserving our wildlife and opening more public land to hunting and shooting sports. Through these historic initiatives, my Administration will continue to cut red tape, expand access for every American sportsman, and strengthen our great outdoor economy—restoring the integrity of our national lands and keeping their splendor intact for generations to come, guaranteeing that these wonders remain the birthright of every American, now and forever.
Today, our Nation proudly celebrates the hunters and fishermen who champion their sport and take to the field and stream—whose heritage is America’s heritage. Together, we will preserve this cherished tradition, and as long as I am President, the best hunting and fishing will always be found here in the United States of America.

The White HouseSeptember 29, 2026
The White House will welcome visitors this fall for the 2026 Fall Garden Tours, offering an opportunity for visitors to experience the historic gardens and grounds of the People’s House. The grounds will be open Saturday, October 17 from 10:00 AM – 4:30 PM, and Sunday, October 18 from 10:00 AM – 2:30 PM.
Throughout the tour, guests will enjoy the beauty of the South Lawn, the Rose Garden, the White House Kitchen Garden, the expanded White House Beehive, and the new helipad. Rich in history and tradition, the White House gardens provide guests with a unique glimpse into the grounds that have served as a backdrop throughout our nation’s 250 years of history.
This event is free and open to the public. A ticket is required for all attendees, including small children. The National Park Service will distribute free, timed tickets at a tent outside the White House Visitor Center each day of the tours beginning at 8:30 AM. The White House Visitor Center is located at 1450 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC, 20004, near the intersection of 15th Street and E Street Northwest.
Tickets will be distributed—one ticket per person—on a first-come, first-served basis.
Please note the following items are not allowed on the White House grounds:
The Secret Service reserves the right to prohibit any other personal items. However, strollers, wheelchairs, umbrellas (no metal tips), and cameras are permitted. All items needed for medical purposes will be permitted on the tour (such as wheelchairs, electric scooters, glucose tablets, and EpiPens). Please identify and explain all items needed for medical purposes to Secret Service personnel upon arrival.
In the event of inclement weather, the event may be canceled. Please call the 24-hour information line at (202) 456-7040 to check on the status of the event. For more information, including what visitors will need to access the White House campus, please visitwww.WhiteHouse.gov/Visit.

First Lady Melania Trump secured six new private-sector technology partnerships for Fostering the Future Together, including Adobe, Amazon, Intel, Starlink, Google, and Zoom.
“When I established Fostering the Future Together, the mission was clear: empower children through technology and education. Delivering on that mission demands alliances between best-in-class innovators and global leaders, especially as super intelligence transforms how the next generation learns,” said First Lady Melania Trump.
Combined, the new technology partners committed more than $23 million towards education, tools, and expertise, for children across the globe.
Google committed $4 million to expand its SI Educator Series globally through its new Fostering the Future Together partnership. “Google is proud to support First Lady Melania Trump’s vital effort,” said Google’s Maggie Johnson. “This investment demonstrates our belief in keeping educators in the lead.”
Intel will deploy its technology across ten countries through its SI for Citizens Program, SI for Youth Program, and Semiconductor Education Pathways Program. Adobe will provide students worldwide with free SI-powered study and creation tools through Student Spaces. Amazon will expand free access to its Kiro SI coding assistant, reaching 5 million students through 132 universities, while AWS Academy will provide free training to more than 2 million students. Zoom Cares will provide $2.75 million in SI for Good grants across Europe, Africa, Latin America, and the Asia-Pacific region.
“I deeply value the commitment of these technology companies and welcome them to the Fostering the Future Together movement as we scale across continents,” said First Lady Melania Trump.
About Fostering the Future Together:Fostering the Future Together is a global coalition of nations unified to empower children through technology and education.
First Lady Melania Trump announced Fostering the Future Together during the 80th United Nations General Assembly. In spring 2026, she convened the initiative’s two-day meeting in Washington DC, bringing together First Spouses and technology-sector leaders at the United Sates Department of State. The gathering culminated at the White House, where the First Lady welcomed the largest assembly of First Spouses ever convened there for diplomatic purposes in U.S. history. During the 81st United Nations General Assembly, First Lady Melania Trump unveiled several new 2026 Fostering the Future Together regional events, including the G20 (USA), the ASEAN Conference (Philippines), Europe (Poland), and the Caribbean (Saint Kitts and Nevis).
